record_type_quote:
In this article, we use nationally representative samples to provide a modern replication of UA
across European nations.

targets.title: Culture’s Consequences: International Differences in Work-Related Values.
targets.evidence_quote:
Items in the IBM questionnaire used by Hofstede for computing his original uncertainty
avoidance index (Hofstede, 1980, 2001)
targets.outcome_quote:
We have successfully replicated Hofstede’s UA dimension with nationally representative samples
from Europe, using three highly intercorrelated items from ESS 2010 that form a strong single factor.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors explicitly conclude successful replication of the IBM uncertainty-avoidance dimension in nationally representative ESS samples. The 2001 second edition is another account of the same original IBM finding, not an independent target. Earlier replication attempts, other dimensions, and external validation sources are contextual or validation comparisons, not separately retested originals.

reasoning: The central test uses a different sample, ESS 2010, to replicate the published IBM uncertainty-avoidance finding. The preliminary examination of the European subset of IBM data checks suitability of the sampling frame, rather than constituting the central reproduction attempt.
